title: Solidity and smart contracts
description: Conventions for Solidity and smart contracts.

rules.title: Checks-effects-interactions
rules.text: Follow checks-effects-interactions and use reentrancy guards around external calls.

rules.title: Audited libraries
rules.text: Build on audited libraries such as OpenZeppelin instead of custom implementations.

rules.title: Explicit access control
rules.text: Restrict privileged functions with explicit access control and emit events for state changes.

rules.title: Safe arithmetic
rules.text: Use the compiler checked arithmetic and be deliberate with unchecked blocks.

rules.title: Fuzz and invariant tests
rules.text: Cover contracts with unit, fuzz and invariant tests and run static analysis such as Slither.

rules.title: Upgradeability with care
rules.text: Avoid upgradeable proxies unless required, and document storage layout rules when used.
